svg.title: Flask
svg.desc: Erlenmeyer flask with narrow neck, graduations, glass wall, liquid meniscus, and suspended culture material. Biological basis: The conical vessel supports mixing with reduced splashing; a curved meniscus and graduations communicate liquid volume.
